pages.title: Mobs Scale With Time & Distance
pages.text: $(li)The longer you play and the farther from spawn, the better gear mobs carry$(li)Rare mob gear chance rises every $(thing)[X] days$()$(li)Past $(thing)[X] blocks$() from spawn, gear tier rises every extra $(thing)[X] blocks$()

pages.title: Bosses: Autoleveling
pages.text: $(li)Boss level scales with $(thing)distance from spawn$(), capped at $(item)Level 100$()$(li)Each extra player in the fight adds $(item)bonus health$()$(li)Check distance and gear up before engaging - groups mean longer fights
